title: Billy Libby – Disruptive Venture Funding at Upper90 (Capital Allocators, EP.251)

reader_summary.headline: Billy Libby is the co-founder of Upper90.
reader_summary.overview: Billy Libby is the co-founder of Upper90. Billy partnered with Jason Finger, the founder of Seamless, to address a capital structure inefficiency in the venture world. Upper90 has deployed a $1 billion of capital for an LP base of more than 300 entrepreneurs.

key_points.text: Billy Libby is the co-founder of Upper90.
Our conversation covers Billy's background in electronic trading, formation of an investment club that brought together quantitative investors and tech founders.
We discuss Upper90s approach to investing in tech start-ups, use of data to find lendable opportunities, sourcing and diligence of deals.
